# ScriptClientContext

*Client*

Context of a client script function, passed as `c`: the running script and function, the subject and object entities of the event, the client world, values given by the event and the result the event reacts to.

## Methods

### setScript {#setscript}

::: member

Changes which script this context names, for Java code that reuses a context; it does not run anything.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `script` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | script ID |

:::

### setFunction {#setfunction}

::: member

Changes which function this context names, for Java code that reuses a context; it does not run anything.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `function` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | function name |

:::

### getScript {#getscript}

::: member

**Returns** [`String`](/scripting/js/String) — ID of the running script, or an empty string if the context was made outside a script

:::

### getFunction {#getfunction}

::: member

**Returns** [`String`](/scripting/js/String) — name of the running function, like `"main"`

:::

### getSubject {#getsubject}

::: member

```js
function main(c) {
    var subject = c.getSubject();

    if (subject != null) {
        c.send(subject.getName() + " started the event");
    }
}
```

**Returns** `ScriptClientEntity<?>` — the entity that caused the event (e.g. the player who clicked or the attacker), or null if the event has none

:::

### getObject {#getobject}

::: member

**Returns** `ScriptClientEntity<?>` — the entity the event happened to (e.g. the clicked or damaged entity), or null if the event has none

:::

### getPlayer {#getplayer}

::: member

**Returns** [`ScriptClientPlayer`](/scripting/client/entity/ScriptClientPlayer) — the subject if it is a player, else the object if it is a player, else null

:::

### getWorld {#getworld}

::: member

**Returns** [`ScriptClientWorld`](/scripting/client/ScriptClientWorld) — the world the event happened in, or null if the event has no world

:::

### getValues {#getvalues}

::: member

**Returns** `Map<String,Any>` — the values the event gave to this function, by name; changes to the map are seen by later calls with this context

:::

### setValues {#setvalues}

::: member

Replaces all values of the context.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `values` | `Map<String,Any>` | new values by name, not null; used as is, not copied |

:::

### setValue {#setvalue}

::: member

Stores a value in the context, e.g. to pass it to a function called with this context.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `key` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | value name |
| `value` | `Any` | value, or null |

:::

### getValue {#getvalue}

::: member

Reads a value the event gave to this function; the names are listed in the description of each event.

```js
function main(c) {
    var damage = c.getValue("damage");

    c.send("Damage: " + damage);
}
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `key` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | value name |

**Returns** `Any` — the value, or null if the event gave no value with this name

:::

### getResultType {#getresulttype}

::: member

**Returns** `ActionResult` — result set by [`success()`](#success), [`consume()`](#consume), [`consumePartial()`](#consumepartial), [`pass()`](#pass) or [`fail()`](#fail); `PASS` by default

:::

### isServer {#isserver}

::: member

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — false for a client script

:::

### getSchedules {#getschedules}

::: member

```js
c.getSchedules().execute(function () {
    c.send("Three seconds later");
}, 60);
```

**Returns** [`ScramSchedules`](/scripting/common/scram/ScramSchedules) — scheduler of code and script functions that run later on the client, after a number of ticks

:::

### sendPacket {#sendpacket}

::: member

Sends a packet to the server handler registered with `scram.registerServerPacket`; an unknown id is ignored there.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `serverPacketId` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | id of the server handler; the editor suggests the ids registered so far. |
| `buffer` | [`ScramBuffer`](/scripting/common/ScramBuffer) | data of the packet, written with the buffer's methods |

:::

### send {#send}

::: member

Shows a chat message to the local player; only on this client.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `message` | `Any` | [`ScriptText`](/scripting/common/ScriptText) (keeps its style, see `scram.text()`) or any value, shown as plain text. |

:::

### success {#success}

::: member

Marks the event as handled: an interaction counts as done (the hand swings) and the game does not handle it further.

:::

### consume {#consume}

::: member

Marks the event as handled without the hand swing: the game does not handle it further.

:::

### consumePartial {#consumepartial}

::: member

Marks the event as handled without the hand swing and without counting the use in statistics.

:::

### pass {#pass}

::: member

Lets the game handle the event as usual; this is the default.

:::

### fail {#fail}

::: member

Cancels the event: a cancellable action (damage, death, a block break and so on) does not happen.

```js
function main(c) {
    // In the entity_damage event: no damage from cacti
    if (c.getValue("damageType") == "cactus") {
        c.fail();
    }
}
```

:::

### copy {#copy}

::: member

**Returns** [`ScriptClientContext`](/scripting/client/ScriptClientContext) — new context with the same script, function, entities, world, result and values (the value map is shared)

:::
